Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PATTERN
Unexamined belief

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.intro:
HOOK
Turn this moment into a 60-second mind game.

MISSION
Concerns interrupt because none has an allocated agenda.

GAME MOVE
Turn the thought into something you can move, shrink, mute, or rotate. Move before the mood votes.
rituals.play:
🎮 SHAPE-SHIFT
Turn the thought into something you can move, shrink, mute, or rotate.

1. Picture Topic — Picture each topic as a meeting item with desired decision, time allowance, and required evidence.
2. Order — Order by consequence and deadline.
3. Place Interruption — Process only the first item; place every interruption in the parking lot for its scheduled turn.

⚡ FINISH MOVE — Use one fast, safe action.
rituals.winReward:
🏆 YOU WIN WHEN
You can see one choice that was hidden a moment ago.

✨ LOCK IT IN
Carry only the useful part forward.
rituals.formulaFlow: Picture Topic → Order → Place Interruption → Notice the shift
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Keep capacity for emergencies that legitimately override the agenda.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.triggerPlayTime:
TRIGGER

PATTERN
Observer loss

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.intro:
HOOK
This pattern looks powerful because it moves fast. Slow it once.

MISSION
Objects dominate because intervals are treated as nothing.

GAME MOVE
Play with the inner picture instead of arguing with every word.
rituals.play:
🎮 VOICE SWITCH
Give the thought a silly, slow, or distant voice so you can hear its trick.

1. Choose Forms — Choose three forms.
2. Attend Space — Attend to the space inside openings, around edges, and between objects.
3. Reverse Figure — Reverse figure and ground until space becomes as perceptible as matter.
4. Include Room — Include the room around your body.

⚡ FINISH MOVE — Use one fast, safe action.

🏆 YOU WIN WHEN
The thought is still there, but it is no longer driving.

✨ LOCK IT IN
Carry only the useful part forward.

rituals.title: CHANGE THE SYMBOL’S JOB
rituals.triggerPlayTime:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PATTERN
Automatic-pattern blindness

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.intro:
HOOK
You only need one small shift—not a perfect mood.

MISSION
Unspoken experience may respond to transformation before explanation.

GAME MOVE
Move before the mood votes. Use the reality duel move, then choose one clear next step.
rituals.play:
🎮 REALITY DUEL
Let the thought and reality face each other. Only clear facts score.

1. Choose Image — Choose the image or object that represents the state.
2. Open Cage — Alter one property—open the cage, cool the metal, add roots, repair the crack, move the weight, give the storm a shoreline.
3. Observe Inner — Observe the inner response and translate it into one practical move.

⚡ FINISH MOVE — Use one fast, safe action.
rituals.winReward:
🏆 YOU WIN WHEN
The thought feels smaller, slower, or less certain.

✨ LOCK IT IN
Let the new view stay for ten seconds.
rituals.formulaFlow: Choose Image → Open Cage → Observe Inner → Notice the shift
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
End the exercise when imagery grows disturbing, bizarre, or detached from reality.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: CONSTRAINTS ENTER BEFORE OPTIONS
rituals.triggerPlayTime:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PATTERN
Boundary confusion

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.intro:
HOOK
The thought has one favourite trick. This game exposes it.

MISSION
Must-have limits should shape the field before desire fills it.

GAME MOVE
Play with the inner picture instead of arguing with every word.
rituals.play:
🎮 CONTROL ROOM
Imagine one simple control panel inside your mind.

1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.

⚡ FINISH MOVE — Use one fast, safe action.
rituals.winReward:
🏆 YOU WIN WHEN
The urge loses some of its command.

✨ LOCK IT IN
Lock in the change with one slow breath.
rituals.formulaFlow: Picture Safety → Eliminate → Generate → Treat → Notice the shift
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Challenge assumed constraints that lack factual support.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
